text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
choice_data_list: ...Hot? Should I turn down the A/C?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no! I'm fine! My body does feel hot, 
that's true, but—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
What I want to cool down is the burning 
fire in my heart!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
My excitement hasn't stopped for a while 
now. —Just thinking about getting to show 
off my strength♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Cool-down finisheed! Please keep 
your eyes on me too, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Where I bring the house down with cheers.
